CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Last_Shopify_Order_Date__c), "Never Ordered", IF(Last_Shopify_Order_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -18), "Month 18+", IF(Last_Shopify_Order_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -17), "Month 17", IF(Last_Shopify_Order_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -15), "Month 15", IF(Last_Shopify_Order_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -12), "Month 12", "Active")))))
CustomField.label: Inactivity Stage
